title: Completed and finite coefficient module categories and scalar restriction
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and any scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme] with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Put $C_n=(R/\varpi^{n+1})_X$ for $n\in\mathbf N$ and $B=\varprojlim_n C_n$, with projection $\pi_n:B\to C_n$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Define $\mathcal M_B=\operatorname{Mod}(B)$ and $\mathcal M_n=\operatorname{Mod}(C_n)$ to be the categories of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with their standard unbounded derived localizations $D(\mathcal M_B)$ and $D(\mathcal M_n)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Use the prescribed small model of the site in the module universe. Define $\operatorname{Res}_{\pi_n}:\mathcal M_n\to\mathcal M_B$ by restriction of the scalar action along $\pi_n$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], leaving the underlying additive sheaf and maps unchanged, and its derived restriction by termwise restriction followed by localization. The scheme and coefficient universes are independent.
